name: Music
summary: MiniMax Music 3 using verified Q6_K GGUF; faster 10-second audio generation. Longer songs remain unqualified.

source.notes: Official Music3 30-step workflow and native SelectCLIPDevice gpu:0 with upstream CLIP rebinding fix PR #16970. Only diffusion model is switched from FP16 DiT to Abiray Q6_K GGUF, leaving MiniMax3 TE 8.8GB INT8, VAE/decoder, sampler and user controls unchanged. Cloud9 2026-11-23 same-seed real 10-second benchmarks: FP16 380.14s, Q6 XFS 367.59s and Q6 NVMe 358.04s. Full-decoded stereo MP3 signal objectively matches FP16 zero-lag 16kHz PCM Pearson 0.99954 and Q6 XFS 1.00000; no human subjective listening done. 60-second default and longer durations remain UNQUALIFIED. Host native memory pressure safeguards unchanged; older FP16 weights and release retained for rollback. Source evidence Freefield/ComfyUI/benchmarks/01c-minimax-q6-music3-10s-nvme-20261123.json.
